paite: Huan David tapa Solomon agamsung ah hatsak in a-om a; TOUPA a Pathian akiang ah a-om a, nakpi mahmah in athupisak hi.
heading: Kumpipa Solomon In Pilna Angen / (1 Kum 3.1-15)
english: Solomon the son of David was firmly established in his kingdom, and Yahweh his God was with him, and made him exceedingly great.

paite: Solomon in Israel tengteng, sepaih sangkhat heutu, zakhat heutu, vaihawmmi, Israel gam tengteng a milian, inkuan a makaipen tengteng ahoupih hi.
english: Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to every prince in all Israel, the heads of the fathers’ households.

paite: Huchi in Solomon leh kikhawm tengteng Gibeon a mun sang ah ahoh ua; huai ah TOUPA sikha Mosi in gamdai a abawl Pathian biakna buk a-om hi.
english: Then Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for God’s Tent of Meeting was there, which Yahweh’s servant Moses had made in the wilderness.

paite: Pathian bawm bel David in ana bawl khitsa mun, Kiriath-jearim a kipan David in alatou khin a; Jerusalem ah akoihna ding puanin azak khitsa him ahi.
english: But David had brought God’s ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

paite: Huan Hur tapa, Uri tapa, Bezalel bawl dal maitam TOUPA biakna buk chin ah a-om behlap a; Solomon leh mipite'n ava zuan uhi.
english: Moreover the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was there before Yahweh’s tabernacle; and Solomon and the assembly were seeking counsel there.

paite: Huan kihoupihna biakbuk chin a dal maitam omna TOUPA ma ah Solomon ahohtou a, halmang thillat sangkhat alan hi.
english: Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before Yahweh, which was at the Tent of Meeting, and offered one thousand burnt offerings on it.

paite: Huai zan in Solomon kiang ah Pathian akilak a, akiang ah, "Bang ahia ka hon piak ding hon ngen in," achi hi.
english: That night, God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for what you want me to give you.”

paite: Huchi in Solomon in Pathian kiang ah, "Ka pa David kiang ah hehpihna thupitak na langsak a, asik in kumpipa in na hon bawlta a,
english: Solomon said to God, “You have shown great loving kindness to David my father, and have made me king in his place.

paite: aw TOUPA Pathian, ka pa David kiang a na thuchiam hihtangtung in; nang lei a leivui zah mipite kumpipa in na hon bawlta hi.
english: Now, Yahweh God, let your promise to David my father be established; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

paite: Huchi in hiai mipite ma a lut leh pawt a ka omtheihna ding in pilna leh theihna hon pia in; na mi hiai zahzah vai, kua'n ahia hawmsak thei ding?" achi hi.
english: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people of yours?”

paite: Huchi in Pathian in Solomon kiang ah, "Hichibang lungsim na put a, sum-le-paite, hauhsaknate, pahtawinate, nang hon mudahte hinnate ngen lou a, damsawtnate leng ngen lou a, atung ua kumpipa a ka hon bawl na mite vai na hawmsak theihna ding a pilna leh theihnate na hon nget zawk ziak in, pilna leh theihna piak na hita hi.
english: God said to Solomon, “Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, honor, or the life of those who hate you, nor yet have you asked for long life; but have asked for wisdom and knowledge for yourself, that you may judge my people, over whom I have made you king,

paite: Huchi in na ma a kumpipate'n ana neih ngei louh uh, nang nung a leng aneih het louh ding uh sum-le-paite, hauhsaknate, pahtawinate ka hon pe lai ding," achi hi.
english: therefore wisdom and knowledge is granted to you. I will give you riches, wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings have had who have been before you, and none after you will have.”

paite: Huchi in Solomon mun sang chin a kihoupihna biakbuk omna Gibeon a zin Jerusalem ah apai a, Israel tung ah yai ahawmta hi.
heading: Kumpipa Solomon Thilhihtheihna Leh Hauhsakna / (1 Kum 10.26-29)
english: So Solomon came from the high place that was at Gibeon, from before the Tent of Meeting, to Jerusalem; and he reigned over Israel.

paite: Huan Solomon in kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite akaikhawm a; kangtalai sangkhat-le-zali leh sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei a, huaite kangtalai koihna khuate leh Jerusalem a kumpipa omnate ah akoih hi.
english: Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen that he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n Jerusalem ah suangtum bang mai in dangka-eng leh dangkasikte akoih a, sidar singte leng phaizang a theipi sing bang a tam in akoih lai hi.
english: The king made silver and gold to be as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars to be as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

paite: Solomon neih sakolte, Aigupta gam a kipan a lakkhiak ahi a; kumpipa sumsin mite'n huaite ahonhon in akhak zel ua, ahon a lei zel ahi.
english: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt and from Kue. The king’s merchants purchased them from Kue.

paite: Aiguptate gam a kangtalaite bel dangkasik shekel zaguk zel in aleikhiaksak zel ua; sakolte dangkasik shekel za-le-sawmnga zel in; huchi mah bang in Hitte kumpipa tengteng leh Siria kumpipate kiang ah leng azuaksawn zel uhi.
english: They imported from Egypt then exported a chariot for six hundred pieces of silver and a horse for one hundred fifty. They also exported them to the Hittite kings and the Syrian kings.
